articles.title: What Time Should You Eat Thanksgiving Dinner? Here’s What Etiquette Experts Say
articles.summary: As households across America prepare to gather for their Thanksgiving celebrations , there’s one question at the forefront of hosts’ minds: what time should dinner be served? A quick glance on social media will tell you that it’s a hotly-debated topic, and one that people have firm opinions on. Lifestyle expert Martha Stewart’s online publication conducted a poll in 2024, asking readers what time Thanksgiving dinner should start. articles.title: People Are Getting Worse at Handling Uncertainty
articles.summary: Living with the unknown isn’t always easy. Not knowing if layoffs are headed your way or whether you’ll be able to afford rent would be difficult for anyone. But when the pressure of the unknown becomes so intense it interferes with daily life, this “intolerance of uncertainty,” as psychologists call it, becomes a risk factor for mental-health disorders, primarily anxiety and depression.
